releases.title: TuneBar v1.2.9: First-Boot Registration & Telemetry Fixes
releases.changelog:
• Enforced First-Boot Registration & Cloud Notice modal on screen.
• Immediate boot telemetry ping-home unblocked across Wi-Fi reconnects.
• Removed audio-player starvation of telemetry upload batches.
• Per-device table isolation (TB_<hash>) with dedicated telemetry.php dashboard.
• Full Web Remote Secrets Manager card for /secrets.ini editing and endpoint override.
• Server-side hardware authentication guard on AI Voice Assistant (ask.php).
